IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Anderson, Hunter, Rodne, and McIntire

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a comprehensive approach to improve mathematics education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mathematics essential learning requirements,standards, curriculum, and instruction; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to take acomprehensive approach to immediately improve the standards,curriculum, instruction, and student achievement in mathematics inWashington's public schools.
